caption: A headlamp is turned from side to side in a dark cave, and the beam sweeps across the cave walls with each turn.

sa.check: A headlamp is worn in a cave.
It is turned from side to side.
The beam sweeps across the cave walls with each turn.

pc.expect: The lit patch moves exactly with the lamp and the wall it turns away from goes dark.
pc.fail: The patch stays put while the lamp turns; or the wall stays lit after the beam leaves; or the patch moves opposite.

pc.expect: The patch moves only as the lamp turns.
pc.fail: It drifts with the lamp still; or moves before the turn; or flickers.

pc.expect: The patch is one bright spot, brightest at its centre.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or it is even edge to edge.

pc.expect: Shadows on the wall point away from the lamp.
pc.fail: They point toward it; or in several directions; or there are none on rough rock.
A second patch appears; or the lamp vanishes; or the beam becomes solid.

pc.expect: The cave walls stay the same.
pc.fail: The rock changes shape; or changes colour rather than brightness; or the cave rearranges.

note: The head turning is the trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
